_note: Written by `python -m twm.sensor_camera register`, controls tuned by hand. Identity is the USB port, not the serial: re-plugging into another port means running register again. Controls are applied IN ORDER at every open, and the order matters - auto_exposure=1 before exposure_time_absolute, white_balance_automatic=0 before the temperature, because the manual value is read-only while its automatic is on. Everything that can drift is pinned so both cameras produce comparable frames and nothing changes mid-episode. exposure_time_absolute=330 is 33 ms, the ceiling at 30 fps. focus_absolute=68 is the driver default and must be re-checked once the cameras are mounted at their working distance.
